name: Baehakis Honest Review Rewards for WooCommerce
author: baehakis

sections.description:
Baehakis Honest Review Rewards for WooCommerce keeps review incentives simple, lightweight, and compliant-minded.

Free features:

  • Send a coupon after review approval
  • Reward verified buyers only
  • One reward per product, order, and customer
  • Reward honest reviews regardless of star rating
  • Choose percentage, fixed-cart, or free-shipping coupons
  • Set coupon expiry
  • Use a simple built-in email template
  • View a reward log
  • Prevent duplicate reward abuse
  • Show a review incentive message with a shortcode
  • Append a disclosure note to rewarded reviews

Why it is different:

  • Built for default WooCommerce reviews
  • No external email API required
  • Rewards honest reviews equally regardless of rating
  • Focused on quick setup instead of heavy review-marketing features
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce reviews are enabled.
  4. Open the setup wizard or WooCommerce > Review Rewards to configure coupon settings.
  5. Add [baehrr_review_reward_message] where you want to explain the reward.
sections.faq:
Does this reward only 5-star reviews?

No. The plugin is designed to reward honest reviews and should not be used to condition rewards on positive feedback.

Does it work with default WooCommerce reviews?

Yes. It uses the standard WooCommerce product review workflow.

How is duplicate abuse prevented?

The free version prevents duplicate rewards by comment, customer, product, and matching order. The Pro add-on can also block duplicates by IP address and export the reward log.
